literal_affine_deviation_map: z0 = [1, -1, 1, 1]^T; each v_k is independent in [-1,1]^2
source_notes: This is the literal 7-update script-affine recurrence. Its A(1,2) entry is cosd(xbar2), as written in the script, and is not the derivative of the printed nonlinear map.
The manuscript variant reports 8 updates and prints a different A(1,2) coefficient. These identities are not merged.
The script's optional nonlinear-correction recurrence is not represented by this affine case.
Three-dimensional plots are coordinate projections of this 4D state set.
assurance: binary64 numerical; no validated rounding certificate
